entities.name: PDU Session
entities.description: A protocol data unit session that can be initiated with IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6 session types for IP address allocation.

entities.name: IPv4 PDU Session Type
entities.description: PDU session type where only IPv4 address is allocated to the UE.

entities.name: IPv6 PDU Session Type
entities.description: PDU session type where IPv6 prefix and interface identifier for IPv6 link local address are allocated to the UE.

entities.name: IPv4v6 PDU Session Type
entities.description: PDU session type where both IPv4 address and IPv6 prefix with interface identifier are allocated to the UE.

entities.name: Session Management Function
entities.description: Network function responsible for IP address allocation based on selected PDU session type and operator policies.

entities.name: Suggested Interface Identifier IE
entities.description: Information element in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message that suggests the interface identifier for IPv6 link local address.

entities.name: IPv4 Address Allocation
entities.description: Process where UE obtains IPv4 address via NAS signalling or IPv4 configuration parameters via DHCPv4 or other methods.

entities.name: IPv6 Address Allocation
entities.description: Process where UE builds IPv6 link local address, obtains /64 IPv6 prefix via stateless autoconfiguration, and may get configuration parameters via stateless DHCPv6 or Router Advertisement.

relations.description: PDU session can be initiated with IPv4 session type.
PDU session can be initiated with IPv6 session type.
PDU session can be initiated with IPv4v6 session type.
SMF performs IPv4 address allocation for IPv4 and IPv4v6 session types.
SMF performs IPv6 prefix and interface identifier allocation for IPv6 and IPv4v6 session types.
If Suggested Interface Identifier IE is present, SMF allocates the indicated interface identifier for IPv6 link local address.
